status: planned — NOT built; byte-preserving re-chunk of a locked legacy FineWeb-Edu flat-token stream into the approved 2**26+1 contract. No re-tokenization, no reordering: the flat logical token stream is preserved exactly.
dataset: a locked legacy FineWeb-Edu flat-token stream (pre-existing binary objects; the exact logical token count is pinned by the lock, not asserted by this recipe)
source_note: uri and expected_logical_tokens are null ON PURPOSE: the locked legacy stream location, its ordered object inventory (name, size, sha256, tokens), and — when the true count is known — the exact expected logical token count are REQUIRED lock inputs (pass --source-uri at lock time), never invented. Locking fails clearly until the real location is supplied, and finalize reconciles the emitted total against the locked inventory's logical count.
tokenizer_note: no tokenization happens on this path (the stream is already tokens); the tokenizer fields are schema-required but unused, and bos/eos pins below are the legacy stream's own published values
hash_seed_note: unused on the legacy path (no keying); pinned to a fixed value so the recipe is fully deterministic

validation_reservation.method: domain-separated keyed hash of the document key

validation_note: the legacy stream carries no document keys, so no validation split is derived on this path; validation comes from the full build
ordering: locked object order IS the stream order (preserved exactly)
encoding: inherited — the legacy stream's own [BOS] + tokens + [EOS] framing is preserved byte-for-byte
publish_root_note: immutable publish destination is pinned by the lock phase at build time (pass --publish-root at lock time)

legacy.description: the locked legacy flat-token stream, re-chunked byte-preservingly into 2**26+1 objects

identity: no identity until built: a built corpus is identified by its manifest.json canonical sha256, verified at read time
